paragraphs.en: Silver was struck by the sudden disappointment but quickly regained composure. Whispering to Jim, he passed him a double-barrelled pistol and began moving northward, distancing himself from the others.
paragraphs.zh: 赛勒斯被突如其来的失望击中，但很快恢复了镇定。他低声对吉姆说了几句，递给他一把双筒手枪，然后朝北方走去，与其他人拉开了距离。

paragraphs.en: "Jim," Silver murmured, "take this and be ready for trouble."
paragraphs.zh: “吉姆，”赛勒斯低声道，“拿着这个，准备好应对麻烦了。”

paragraphs.en: Morgan found a two-guinea piece, which caused an uproar among the buccaneers. Merry accused Silver of knowing all along, shouting, "Two guineas! That's your seven hundred thousand pounds?
paragraphs.zh: 摩根捡到了一枚两镑的硬币，这一发现立刻引起了海盗们的轩然大波。梅里指控锡尔弗早就知道这件事，喊道：“两镑！那就是你那七百万英镑？”

paragraphs.en: You're always making deals!"
paragraphs.zh: 你总是搞什么交易！

paragraphs.en: Silver responded with cool insolence, saying, "Keep digging; you'll find some pig-nuts."
paragraphs.zh: 银色回应道，语气冷淡而傲慢：“继续挖吧，你可能会找到些猪坚果。”

paragraphs.en: Merry retorted angrily, "Pig-nuts! They know he knew it all along. Look at his face."
paragraphs.zh: 梅里气愤地反驳道：“就知道！他们明明早就知道了。你看他的脸色。”

paragraphs.en: Silver replied, "Ah, Merry, standing for captain again? You're a determined lad."
paragraphs.zh: 银色回答道：“啊，梅里，再次担任船长？你真是个意志坚定的小伙子。”

paragraphs.en: Despite the tension, everyone scrambled out of the pit, with Silver on one side and the others on the opposite side.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管气氛紧张，大家还是纷纷从坑里爬了出来，Silver站在一边，其他人则站在对面。

paragraphs.en: We stood facing each other: two against five, separated by the pit. Silver remained still, watching them from his crutch, showing no signs of aggression. He was calm and brave.
paragraphs.zh: 我们面对面站着：一比五，中间隔着那个坑。银依然静静地站在拐杖上，目光注视着对方，没有任何攻击的迹象。他镇定自若，勇敢无畏。

paragraphs.en: Finally, Merry suggested a speech might resolve the situation.
paragraphs.zh: 梅里最终建议发表一番言论或许能解决问题。

paragraphs.en: Silver called out to his mates, "Mates, there are two of them alone over there. One is the old cripple who brought us here and messed things up; the other is that cub I intend to take down." He was about to lead a charge when three musket shots rang out from the bushes.
paragraphs.zh: Silver对着他的同伴喊道：“伙计们，那边只有两个人。一个是带我们来的那个老 cripple，他把事情搞砸了；另一个是我打算对付的小子。”他正要发起冲锋，这时从灌木丛中传来三声火枪响。

paragraphs.en: Merry tumbled headfirst into an excavation, while the man with the bandage spun like a top and fell dead. The remaining three fled.
paragraphs.zh: 梅里头朝下栽进了挖掘坑中，而裹着绷带的男人则像陀螺一样旋转，最终倒地身亡。剩下的三个人四散逃走了。

paragraphs.en: Before anyone could react, Long John fired two pistol barrels at Merry as he struggled. As Merry's eyes rolled up in his last moments, Silver said, "George, I reckon I got you."
paragraphs.zh: 还没等任何人反应过来，长约翰就在梅里挣扎时连开两枪。只见梅里的双眼在最后一刻上翻，银色的声音脱口而出：“乔治，我想我赢了你。”

paragraphs.en: Doctor Livesey, Gray, and Ben Gunn arrived from among the nutmeg trees with smoking muskets. "Forward!" cried Doctor Livesey.
paragraphs.zh: 医生利文斯通、格雷和本·古恩从肉豆蔻树丛中出来，手中拿着冒着烟的火枪。“前进！”利文斯通医生喊道。

paragraphs.en: "Double quick, my lads. We must intercept them before they reach the boats." They sprinted towards the chest.
paragraphs.zh: “快点，伙计们。我们必须在他们登上船之前截住他们。”他们疾奔向那堆箱子。

paragraphs.en: Silver was eager to keep up. He hopped on his crutch, working up a sweat, and was already thirty yards behind when they reached the slope's top. "Doctor," he called out, "look there!
paragraphs.zh: 赛弗尔急切地想跟上他们的步伐，拄着拐杖一瘸一拐地追赶，很快就落后了三十多 yard。他喘着气喊道：“医生，你看那边！”

paragraphs.en: No hurry!"
paragraphs.zh: “不用急！”

paragraphs.en: Indeed, there was no rush. In an open area of the plateau, they saw the three survivors running towards Mizzenmast Hill in the same direction they had started. They were between them and the boats.
paragraphs.zh: 实际上，并没有急迫的必要。在高原的一片开阔地带，他们看见那三个幸存者正朝米森mast山的方向奔跑，与他们出发的方向相同。这三人就在他们和船只之间。

paragraphs.en: The four sat down to catch their breath as Long John approached.
paragraphs.zh: 长约翰走近时，四人坐下来喘了口气。

paragraphs.en: "Thank ye kindly, doctor," said Silver. "You came just in time for me and Hawkins. And there you are, Ben Gunn!"
paragraphs.zh: “多谢你及时赶到，医生，”锡尔弗说道，“你们正好赶上了我和霍金斯。而你呢，本·古恩！”

paragraphs.en: he added with a grin. "Well, you're a nice one, indeed."
paragraphs.zh: 他露齿一笑，“你可真会说啊。”

paragraphs.en: "I'm Ben Gunn," replied the maroon, wriggling uncomfortably. After a pause, he said, "How do, Mr. Silver? Pretty well, I thank ye."
paragraphs.zh: “我是本·冈恩，”那名海盗局促不安地回答道。“银先生好，我挺好的，谢谢。”

paragraphs.en: The doctor sent Gray back for one of the mutineers' abandoned pick-axes. As they descended leisurely towards the boats, he recounted Ben Gunn's story, which deeply interested Silver.
paragraphs.zh: 医生让格雷回去取了一把叛乱者遗弃的镐头。随着他们悠闲地下降到小船旁，格雷讲述了本·古恩的故事，这故事深深吸引了银狐的注意。

paragraphs.en: Ben Gunn, a marooned half-idiot, had discovered the skeleton and the treasure on his long island wanderings. He carried the treasure on his back for many journeys from the pine tree to a cave on the northeastern hill. The treasure lay safely stored there since two months before the HISPANIOLA's arrival.
paragraphs.zh: 贝恩·古恩，这位被遗弃的半疯之人，在漫长的岛上游荡中发现了那具骷髅和宝藏。他背着宝藏走了许多次路，从那棵松树下到东北部山丘上的洞穴。自“希帕尼奥拉”号到来前两个月起，宝藏就安全地存放在那里。

paragraphs.en: When attacked, the doctor extracted this secret from Ben Gunn. Seeing the anchorage deserted the next morning, he approached Silver with the now useless chart and supplies, hoping to move safely to the hill and guard the money.
paragraphs.zh: 当遭到攻击时，医生从本·古恩那里挖出了这个秘密。第二天早上发现锚地空无一人后，他拿着这张现在已经没用的航海图和补给品找到了银，希望能安全地前往高地，守护财宝。

paragraphs.en: "Jim," said the doctor, "I did what I thought best for those who stood by their duty. If you weren't one of them, whose fault was it?"
paragraphs.zh: “吉姆，”医生说道，“我认为为了那些恪尽职守的人着想，我已经做出了最好的决定。如果你不属于他们之中，那又是谁的过错呢？”

paragraphs.en: That morning, finding we were part of the mutineers' disappointment, he rushed to the cave with Gray and Ben Gunn, heading diagonally across the island towards the pine tree. However, our party had already taken the lead. Ben Gunn, fleet of foot, went ahead alone.
paragraphs.zh: 那天早晨，得知我们成了叛乱者的失望对象后，他急忙和格雷以及本·古恩一起奔向洞穴，在岛上斜穿过前往松树的方向。然而，我们的队伍已经领先了。本·古恩身手敏捷，独自一人走在前面。

paragraphs.en: Realizing this, Silver decided to exploit his former shipmates' superstitions. This plan worked as Gray and the doctor ambushed the treasure hunters before they arrived.
paragraphs.zh: 意识到这一点后，赛勒斯决定利用他以前船员们的迷信心理。这个计划奏效了，在宝藏猎人到来之前，格雷和医生设下埋伏将他们截住了。

paragraphs.en: "Fortunate for me," said Silver, "that Hawkins is here. You'd have let old John be cut to bits without a second thought, doctor."
paragraphs.zh: “多亏了霍金斯在这里，”锡尔弗说道，“医生，你肯定不会犹豫就让老约翰被切成碎片。”

paragraphs.en: "Not a thought," replied Dr. Livesey cheerfully.
paragraphs.zh: “根本没有想头，”利文斯通医生愉快地回答道。

paragraphs.en: By this time, we had arrived at the gigs. The doctor used the pick-axe to destroy one gig, and then we all boarded the other for our journey around North Inlet by sea.
paragraphs.zh: 这时，我们已经到达了演出地点。医生用撬棍砸毁了一个帐篷，然后我们都上了另一个帐篷，准备乘船游览北 inlet 的海域。

paragraphs.en: The voyage was about eight or nine miles long. Despite his extreme fatigue, Silver rowed alongside us. Soon, we sailed past the straits and rounded the southeast corner of the island where we had towed the HISPANIOLA four days earlier.
paragraphs.zh: 这次航行大约有八九英里长。尽管Silver疲惫不堪，仍与我们并肩划桨。很快，我们便驶过了海峡，并绕过了四天前拖曳“西班牙人号”的东南角。

paragraphs.en: As we passed a two-pointed hill, we saw Ben Gunn's cave with its black entrance and a figure standing by it, leaning on a musket. It was the squire, whom we greeted with handkerchiefs and cheers, including Silver’s hearty response.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们路过一个尖顶小山时，看到了本·古恩的洞穴，洞口黑魆魆的，旁边站着一个人，手里拿着一根步枪倚靠着。那是庄园主，我们用手帕和欢呼声迎接他，其中包括西尔弗热情的回应。

paragraphs.en: Three miles further, just inside North Inlet, we encountered the HISPANIOLA, cruising alone. The last high tide had lifted her; if there had been strong winds or currents, she might have remained undiscovered. Fortunately, only the main-sail was damaged.
paragraphs.zh: 再往前三英里，刚进入北入口时，我们遇到了“海地”号，它独自航行。上次涨潮已经将它抬高；如果有强劲的风或水流，它可能还会一直藏匿未被发现。所幸只是主帆受损。

paragraphs.en: We prepared another anchor and dropped it in about six fathoms of water.
paragraphs.zh: 我们又准备了一副锚，在约十米深的水里抛下了锚。

paragraphs.en: We then returned to Rum Cove, the nearest point to Ben Gunn's treasure-house. Gray went alone back to the HISPANIOLA for the night, guarding her.
paragraphs.zh: 随后我们返回了本·冈恩宝藏屋最近的地点——鲁姆湾。格雷独自一人回到“西班牙牛”号过夜，并负责看守船只。

paragraphs.en: The beach sloped gently up to the cave entrance. At the top, the squire met us. He greeted me cordially without mentioning my escapade, either in praise or blame.
paragraphs.zh: 海滩缓缓上升至洞穴入口，我们在顶端遇到了管家。他热情地向我问好，既没有因我的小插曲而称赞，也没有责备。

paragraphs.en: Upon Silver’s polite salute, he turned red.
paragraphs.zh: 银礼貌地行了一礼，他顿时脸红了。

paragraphs.en: "John Silver," said the squire, "you are a prodigious villain and imposter—a monstrous imposter, sir. I am told I cannot prosecute you. Well, then, I will not.
paragraphs.zh: “约翰·辛普森，”庄园主说道，“你是个无与伦比的恶棍和骗子——一个可怕的骗子，先生。我被告知无法对你提起诉讼。好吧，那我就不会去做了。

paragraphs.en: But the dead men hang about your neck like millstones."
paragraphs.zh: 但那些死者的影子却像磨盘一样沉重地压在你身上。

paragraphs.en: "Thank you kindly, sir," replied Long John, saluting again.
paragraphs.zh: “非常感谢您，先生，”长腿约翰再次敬礼答道。

paragraphs.en: "I dare you to thank me!" cried the squire. "It is a gross dereliction of my duty.
paragraphs.zh: “你敢让我道谢吗！”管家大声喊道，“这可是严重失职。”

paragraphs.en: Stand back."
paragraphs.zh: 退后一点。

paragraphs.en: We entered the cave, a spacious and well-lit place with a small spring and clear water. Ferns hung overhead, and the floor was covered in sand. Captain Smollett lay by a large fire, while in a distant corner, John Silver sat near piles of gold coins and bars.
paragraphs.zh: 我们走进洞穴，这是一个宽敞而明亮的地方，有一股清澈的小泉水。蕨类植物悬挂在上方，地面铺满了沙子。斯莫利特船长躺在一大堆篝火旁，而在远处的一个角落里，约翰·银坐在成堆的金币和金条旁边。

paragraphs.en: "Come in, Jim," said the captain. "You're a good boy, but I don't think we'll sail again. You're too much of a favourite for me."
paragraphs.zh: “吉姆，进来吧，”船长说道，“你是个好孩子，不过我想我们不会再出海了。你对我来说太受欢迎了。”

paragraphs.en: "Come back to your duty, sir," replied Silver.
paragraphs.zh: “回到你的岗位上去吧，先生。”银色回答道。

paragraphs.en: The captain nodded, saying nothing more. That night, we feasted on salted goat from Ben Gunn and some delicacies from the HISPANIOLA, along with a bottle of old wine. The atmosphere was lively and joyful.
paragraphs.zh: 船长点了点头，没有再说什么。当晚，我们享用了一顿丰盛的晚餐，有本·冈恩腌制的山羊和“伊斯帕尼奥拉号”上的一些美味佳肴，还喝了一瓶陈年葡萄酒。气氛欢快而愉悦。

paragraphs.en: Despite sitting in the shadows, Silver ate heartily and joined our laughter, just as he had been during our voyage out.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管坐在阴影中，赛勒斯吃得津津有味，也和我们一起开怀大笑，就像我们在航行出海时一样。
